insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change enables more accurate tracking and fulfillment management.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This change provides more flexibility in tracking and fulfillment, but requires updates to existing code. Ensure that your app handles multiple tracking numbers correctly, and test the updated functionality thoroughly. The GraphQL Admin API will need to be updated to include the new field in the OrderCreateFulfillmentInput type.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate tracking and fulfillment management, with the ability to attach multiple tracking numbers to a single fulfillment. This change will improve the overall shipping and delivery experience for customers.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking and fulfillment, which is critical for merchants and customers alike. By supporting multiple tracking numbers, Shopify is improving the overall shipping and delivery experience.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default --dev-origin for customer account push. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion, enhancing performance.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs, with OAuth state values now using cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: The Shopify AI Toolkit is now recommended in newly scaffolded storefronts, and dependencies have been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing debugging capabilities.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory management has been improved by consolidating in-progress inventory holds, moving from reserved to committed quantities for draft orders, transfers, and shipments.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support has been added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores and manage shopper carts.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing for deployment of Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order management capabilities.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion dominate the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as HTTP/2 support, secure OAuth state values, and recommendations for the Shopify AI Toolkit. The skeleton package was also updated to version 2026.4.6.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: ShopifyQL now includes the shop_campaign_insights schema, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query Shop Campaigns performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
